description:
Delete a tag from a property entirely: unassigns it from every keyword/page and removes the tag itself. type is "keyword", "url" or "both". The built-in Brand / Non-Brand tags cannot be deleted. This does not delete auto-assignment rules that target the tag (use delete_tag_rule for those). Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties.

Cost: 1 credit per call.

Examples:
```json
// Delete a custom tag from both keywords and pages.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","name":"Brand","type":"both"}
```
name: delete_tag
title: Delete tag
